content.short: Cross-chain zkBridge solutions for layer-1 and layer-2 via zero-knowledge proofs for secure, trustless state transitions.
content.description: Polyhedra Network, launched in 2023, delivers cross-chain solutions for both layer-1 and layer-2 ecosystems using zkBridge. This approach relies on zero-knowledge proofs to verify state transitions securely without external assumptions, reducing on-chain verification costs. The system supports more than 20 networks, including BNB Chain, Ethereum, and Arbitrum. Access is available at zkbridge.com or via an oracle integration in compatible cross-chain ecosystems.
